items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: So we hired John, we hired John Kazma. ... Well John plays good music, he plays good enough music for everybody, they like it really.

ctx.x: But he gave us good music. Well, yeah, he gave us good music. He gave us all that we wanted. So we hired John, we hired John Kazma. Any good band we know. We know it's a good band. Just like when we give a dance. We always try to get the good music. You see when you've got a good band you pour the crowd. If you don't have a good band you don't pour no crowd. Just like in my time we used to, there was a hall on Liberty Street, you see, called it, that was the cooperators. And they had one right here on the whistle…
Huh? Yeah, well he was shocked.
